summary: Blocked local writes must fail visibly, Smart Group searches must retain their live scope, and inventory exports with output paths must not be marked read-only.
reason: A blocked batch apply could look successful, a failed scoped search could fall back to unrelated cached records or look like an empty success, and an export that writes a local file was advertised as read-only to MCP callers.
validated_outcome: Synthetic tests verify blocked writes return an API error, failed Smart Group reads never fall back to unscoped local rows, successful scoped results still feed the offline mirror, and inventory export commands are not annotated read-only.
